channel.title: Screen brightness does not change
channel.description:
The brightness of the screen on the laptop does not change, it worked before
'/usr/bin/backlight-tool-dist-agent get' was unable to get the system's current backlight value! Possible causes: - The system does not support display brightness controls. - Your user account is not a member of the 'sudo' or 'privleap' groups.
Output from 'backlight-tool-dist-agent':
[/usr/bin/backlight-tool-dist-handler](#): ERROR: no per-user runtime dir, cannot create a lock directory! [/usr/bin/backlight-tool-dist-agent](#): ERROR: Could not get backlight percentage!

item.title: Screen brightness does not change
item.dc:creator: SpecialBook
item.description:
The brightness of the screen on the laptop does not change, it worked before

‘/usr/bin/backlight-tool-dist-agent get’ was unable to get the system’s current backlight value! Possible causes:

  • The system does not support display brightness controls.
  • Your user account is not a member of the ‘sudo’ or ‘privleap’ groups.

Output from ‘backlight-tool-dist-agent’:

/usr/bin/backlight-tool-dist-handler: ERROR: no per-user runtime dir, cannot create a lock directory!
/usr/bin/backlight-tool-dist-agent: ERROR: Could not get backlight percentage!
